text:
Type: glass-door cabinet with two doors
Use: storing and displaying books, tableware or collections; dining room, living room, study
Style: classic, contemporary
Materials: dark brown stained wood veneer, clear glass doors, wooden adjustable shelves
Colors: dark chocolate brown, warm grey-brown interior
Shape: tall upright cabinet with two framed glass doors, long vertical wooden bar handles, several shelves, short tapered legs, tall and substantial
Feel: refined, stately, warm, calm
Goes with: dark wood, leather chairs, cream walls, brass lamps; classic or contemporary studies and dining rooms

product.name: REGISSR
product.description: Wood is a natural living material, and variations in the grain, colour and texture makes each piece of wood furniture unique.
